en:
You should listen when someone gives 
you a warning...

Or...do you just have some tacky interest
in murderers?

Hmph... I can't tell if you're bold or
just dense...

Well, whatever. I don't really have any
big stories to tell, though...
<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time listening to Ryoma ramble...
<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma and I grew a little closer today.
